questions.prompt: A branch has one subnet for users and another for servers. A packet crosses their router. Which action belongs to the router’s Layer 3 role?

choices.text: Choosing an RF channel for the client
choices.explanation: That is a wireless radio-management function.

choices.text: Learning only the packet’s destination MAC as a source
choices.explanation: MAC source learning is a different Layer 2 operation.

choices.text: Supplying a guest operating-system kernel
choices.explanation: That is unrelated to routing.

choices.text: Selecting a next hop using the destination IP address
choices.explanation: The routing function chooses how to reach the destination network.

questions.explanation: The router chooses a forwarding path in the IP topology. Ethernet headers serve the individual link rather than replacing the IP routing decision.

questions.prompt: A building uses access switches connected to a redundant pair that combines distribution and core functions. What makes this a two-tier campus?

choices.text: Exactly two physical switches exist
choices.explanation: There may be many access switches and two aggregation devices.

choices.text: Distribution and core roles are combined in one tier
choices.explanation: The access tier plus collapsed distribution/core creates two logical tiers.

choices.text: Only two VLANs are supported
choices.explanation: Tier count does not determine VLAN count.

choices.text: Every server must connect directly to every switch
choices.explanation: That is not a collapsed-core requirement.

questions.explanation: Count architectural roles, not chassis. Redundancy within a tier does not create an additional tier.

choices.explanation: The modules can require different optical signaling and fiber.

choices.text: IPv4 private addressing prevents LR operation
choices.explanation: Address classification does not determine optical compatibility.

questions.prompt: A half-duplex legacy Ethernet port records ordinary collisions while transmitting on a correctly sized hub segment. There are no late collisions, errors, or mismatches. What is the sound interpretation?

choices.text: Some collisions are expected during shared-medium contention
choices.explanation: CSMA/CD resolves overlapping attempts on half-duplex shared Ethernet.

choices.text: Any collision proves an IP address conflict
choices.explanation: Collision counters describe link access, not duplicate IP assignments.

choices.text: The interface must actually be full duplex
choices.explanation: Full-duplex operation does not use collisions for access.

choices.text: The hub has learned the wrong MAC address
choices.explanation: A hub does not build a MAC forwarding table.

questions.explanation: An ordinary collision is not automatically a cabling fault in this explicitly half-duplex environment. Interpret counters against the link’s intended operating mode.

questions.prompt: A packet capture shows the first three control exchanges of a standard successful TCP connection. Which sequence is expected?

choices.text: ACK → FIN → SYN
choices.explanation: FIN is used for closing, not this establishment sequence.

choices.text: SYN → SYN → FIN
choices.explanation: This omits the normal acknowledgment progression.

choices.text: FIN → ACK → RST
choices.explanation: These flags describe termination/reset actions.

choices.text: SYN → SYN-ACK → ACK
choices.explanation: This is the normal three-way establishment handshake.

questions.explanation: TCP synchronizes both directions of sequence space during establishment. UDP does not perform this protocol-level handshake.

questions.prompt: A destination host only receives traffic and sends no eligible source frames for longer than the configured MAC aging time. Its dynamic entry expires. Why did received traffic not necessarily keep the entry fresh?

choices.text: Aging occurs only when a VLAN is deleted
choices.explanation: Dynamic entries can expire in an unchanged VLAN.

choices.text: Dynamic learning refreshes location from observed source traffic
choices.explanation: Packets addressed to a host do not prove its current ingress location.

choices.text: The switch refreshes only IPv6 hosts
choices.explanation: Source learning is independent of that IP address family.

choices.text: The destination must be assigned a static IP to prevent aging
choices.explanation: IP assignment method does not itself create a static MAC entry.

questions.explanation: Traffic sent toward a location is not evidence received from that location. Source observations are the basis for ordinary dynamic MAC learning.

questions.prompt: A wireless survey records signal −62 dBm and noise −92 dBm at location A, then signal −62 dBm and noise −75 dBm at location B. Which location has the better signal-to-noise margin?

choices.text: B, because −75 is numerically greater than −92
choices.explanation: The higher noise floor reduces the margin.

choices.text: A, because its signal is 30 dB above noise rather than 13 dB
choices.explanation: Subtract noise from signal in each location.

choices.text: Both, because equal signal strength guarantees equal quality
choices.explanation: Noise differs despite identical received signal.

choices.text: Neither, because negative dBm means no signal exists
choices.explanation: Negative dBm indicates power below 1 mW, not absent power.

questions.explanation: Assess desired signal relative to the noise floor. The same signal power can produce very different margins in different noise conditions.

choices.explanation: A MAC entry does not authorize or perform inter-VLAN routing.

choices.text: The switch ignores VLAN identity in its lookup
choices.explanation: MAC forwarding context includes the VLAN.

choices.text: The destination is unknown within VLAN 10
choices.explanation: A mapping in another VLAN does not supply this lookup.

choices.text: The frame is flooded to the other eligible VLAN 10 ports
choices.explanation: Unknown-unicast flooding remains in the ingress VLAN.

choices.text: The frame must be sent through every port in every VLAN
choices.explanation: Flooding does not remove VLAN boundaries.

questions.explanation: A MAC address table is not a single VLAN-independent location list. Use the entry in the frame’s forwarding context.
